def sliced(seq, n, maxsplit=None):
    """Yield slices of length *n* from the sequence *seq*.

        >>> list(sliced((1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), 3))
        [(1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6)]

    If the length of the sequence is not divisible by the requested slice
    length, the last slice will be shorter.

        >>> list(sliced((1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8), 3))
        [(1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6), (7, 8)]

    This function will only work for iterables that support slicing.
    For non-sliceable iterables, see :func:`chunked`.

    """
    i = 0
    splits = 0
    while True:
        # Determine the end index for this slice
        if maxsplit is None or splits < maxsplit:
            # normal slice of length n
            end = i + n
        else:
            # after maxsplit splits, take the rest of the sequence
            end = len(seq)
        slice_ = seq[i:end]
        if not slice_:
            break
        yield slice_
        i = end
        if maxsplit is not None:
            splits += 1
            if splits >= maxsplit:
                # After reaching maxsplit splits, continue to yield the remainder
                # (if any) in the next iteration (when end == len(seq) will yield empty and break)
                pass
